description:
The Matrix’s kung fu to Kung Fu Panda, Karate Kid, Karate Kid: Legends, and even Bruce Lee’s iconic fights. All these movies reveal some kind of secret power that draw viewers to want to start fighting too. In this video, we break down the real force and power behind martial arts scenes in movies. We speak to a former high ranking martial artist, who was inspired by Bruce Lee movies to start training, and who real soon discovered that real power behind the arts.
